findings.statement: CA9 is up in tumour at RNA (log2FC 6.312) and protein (log2FC 2.269), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 9.712) and stays high at purity 1 (RNA log2FC 7.787), so it is tumour-intrinsic; girentuximab reached PHASE_3.

SCARB1 is up at RNA (log2FC 2.974) and protein (log2FC 1.837); TCGA-KIRC replicates (log2FC 3.989) and purity-1 RNA log2FC is 3.762, so the signal is tumour-cell derived. Top of the target profile, with no CNV loss (loss frequency 0).

CD70 is up at RNA (log2FC 4.464) and protein (log2FC 2.421), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 7.09) and is tumour-intrinsic (purity-1 RNA log2FC 4.278). It is a membrane ligand with clinical-stage CD70-directed agents (cusatuzumab, PHASE_2).

ENPP3 is up at RNA (log2FC 3.895) and protein (log2FC 1.544); TCGA-KIRC log2FC is 5.557 and purity-1 RNA log2FC 5.278. A membrane enzyme with an antibody-drug conjugate (AGS-16C3F, PHASE_2) already tested.

SLC16A3 (MCT4, lactate transporter) is up at RNA (log2FC 3.435) and protein (log2FC 2.279), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 3.291), and has a positive cis copy-number correlation (rho 0.258). It reflects Warburg-type metabolic rewiring.

NNMT is up at RNA (log2FC 4.67) and protein (log2FC 2.709), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 4.685), and higher expression is prognostic for worse survival (log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479). It ranks 2nd in the biomarker profile.

FABP6 is up at RNA (log2FC 4.006) and protein (log2FC 1.921), with a CNV gain frequency of 0.573 and a positive cis effect (rho 0.309), so gain contributes to up-regulation. TCGA-KIRC log2FC is 6.431.
PSAT1 is down in tumour at RNA (log2FC -3.867) and protein (log2FC -1.963). It tops the biomarker profile; TCGA-KIRC log2FC is -2.974 and the survival log HR is 0.43 (padj 5.66e-7).

ALDH6A1 is down at RNA (log2FC -3.399) and protein (log2FC -1.925), with CNV loss frequency 0.355 and a positive cis effect (rho 0.525), consistent with 3p/arm loss dosage. Lower expression goes with worse survival (log HR -0.554, padj 9.45e-12).

PCK1 is strongly down at RNA (log2FC -4.424) and protein (log2FC -1.859), reflecting loss of proximal tubule gluconeogenic identity. Lower expression goes with worse survival (log HR -0.415, padj 1.91e-7).

SLC22A8 (OAT3) is down at RNA (log2FC -6.715) and protein (log2FC -2.264), a tubule-identity loss marker; TCGA-KIRC log2FC is -6.154 and lower expression is prognostic for worse survival (log HR -0.402).

HSD11B2 is down at RNA (log2FC -3.618) and protein (log2FC -1.715); TCGA-KIRC log2FC is -4.456 and lower expression goes with worse survival (log HR -0.356). Carbenoxolone is approved but it inhibits this enzyme, so it does not fit a target role.

VWF is up at RNA (log2FC 3.605) and protein (log2FC 1.284), likely endothelial and vascular. Higher expression goes with better survival (log HR -0.397, padj 1.97e-7), so it is better as a prognostic biomarker than as a target.

caveats: Values come from the convergence_ranking rows (target and biomarker profiles); no per-gene calls to get_de_results, phosphosites or kinase_activity were made, so phospho and kinase layers are not covered.
Mutation recurrence is low for the listed genes; the 3p drivers (VHL, PBRM1, SETD2, BAP1) were not queried here.
DepMap mean effects in ccRCC are weak or non-selective for the top up-regulated genes, so none has demonstrated dependency.
Cohort sizes are small (110 tumours, 75 to 84 matched normals); tumour-vs-normal differences do not prove therapeutic benefit.
Immune and stroma-linked genes (VWF, FCGR3A, FCER1G) partly reflect infiltration rather than tumour-cell expression.
